Class Trainer

java.lang.Object
Trainer
public class Trainer extends Object
NPC trainer that patrols a fixed tile position in the world map.

Uses a simple vertical line-of-sight check (canSeePlayer(int, int)) to detect when the player steps into its sight range and trigger a battle. Once defeated, the trainer is flagged and will no longer initiate battles.
